item.title: Occupational therapy students complete successful placement at Y WA Kalgoorlie Early Learning Centre
item.description: A successful partnership between the Y WA and the Goldfields University Department of Rural Health (GUDRH) has delivered lasting benefits for children, families, educators and future allied health professionals, with two third-year Occupational Therapy students completing a four-week placement at the Y WA Kalgoorlie Early Learning Centre.

item.title: A mission that matters
item.description: Every day in Australia, nine babies and young children die suddenly and unexpectedly. Around 3,000 young lives are lost each year to SIDS, stillbirth and other causes. Red Nose Day aims to change that through research, education and support for families experiencing the death of a baby or child.
